name: aiwander-cpc-toolbelt
description: AIwander CPC tools for Claude: Hands automation skills, optional Workflow / Manager / Voice guidance, and Cache path setup. Does not include Autonomous.

cpc_root.title: CPC install root
cpc_root.description: Windows folder that contains servers\hands.exe (usually C:\CPC). Used by setup skills; not uploaded anywhere.

cpc_cache.title: Cache path
cpc_cache.description: Local Cache directory for continuity skills (default C:\CPC\cache). Path + skills only; no Cache MCP.
